notes:
PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). This package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware was attached, no hardware backend was requested, and no hardware or sim-engine run is claimed. The card's entry symbol robo_manip_baselines.envs.mujoco:MujocoUR5eCableEnv is confirmed in the clone at robo_manip_baselines/envs/mujoco/ur5e/MujocoUR5eCableEnv.py:9 and is registered as robo_manip_baselines/MujocoUR5eCableEnv-v0 at robo_manip_baselines/envs/__init__.py:5-8. The card's family-config decision and GymnasiumDriver helper express the registered Gymnasium environment, so there is no deviation from the card; the other four entry symbols exist but one package serves one device. The upstream package pins gymnasium 1.0.0 and mujoco 3.1.6 (pyproject.toml:33-34); neither is installed where the gate runs and package code never imports or runs the clone, so backends['fake'] is this package's pure-Python kinematic stand-in for the environment. The fake reproduces the three observation shapes (joint_pos 7, joint_vel 7, wrench 6; MujocoUR5eEnvBase.py:25-31 and 84-125), the fixed start pose restored by reset_model (MujocoEnvBase.py:163-165 and MujocoUR5eCableEnv.py:20-30), the seven-actuator action bounds from the model's ctrlrange (ur5e_integrated_shared_config.xml:6-11 and ur5e_integrated_specific_config.xml:13), the 0.004 s x 8 = 32 ms control period (MujocoEnvBase.py:12-13), and terminated=False and truncated=False (MujocoEnvBase.py:82-97). The arm motion, gripper motion and reward are placeholders and are labelled as such in fake.py and in the fidelity gaps. NOT COVERED: the three 640x480 camera RGB/depth images and any tactile intensity maps that the upstream info dictionary carries, MuJoCo rigid-body dynamics, contacts, cable and pole geometry, actuator forces, sensors, noise and the cable reward geometry. The sim backend was not run. Snapshot and restore are not offered because the environment exposes no get_state/set_state. Warnings kept from the last gate run (all expected, none failed): G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only stores the seed for the next reset); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for action_space and reset, which come from the gymnasium MujocoEnv base that is external to the clone; and G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer inputs seed (twice), ticks and action.values[*], which a simulator family gets from the bridge. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was raised. test_driver.py keeps the required check_driver(HERE, backend='fake') call and adds six cases (fixed start pose, step effect and tick, ctrlrange envelope refusal with zero effect, seed class, e-stop latch, published fidelity); they pass. No site-limits.example.json is needed because the driver declares no operator-required limit. No catalogue_requests: only the catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used.
